elements.element: Vendor must maintain commercial general liability insurance of at least USD 1,000,000 per occurrence throughout the Agreement term.
elements.evidence: Section 10.9 requires HDI to maintain commercial general liability insurance of not less than $1,000,000 per occurrence throughout the term.

elements.element: Vendor must maintain commercial general liability insurance with an aggregate limit of at least USD 2,000,000 throughout the Agreement term.
elements.evidence: Section 10.9 requires a commercial general liability aggregate limit of not less than $2,000,000 throughout the term.

elements.element: Vendor must maintain professional liability (errors and omissions) insurance of at least USD 2,000,000 throughout the Agreement term.
elements.evidence: Section 10.9 requires professional liability (errors and omissions) insurance of not less than $2,000,000 throughout the term.

elements.element: If Vendor processes Customer Data, Vendor must maintain cyber and privacy liability insurance of at least USD 5,000,000 throughout the Agreement term.
elements.evidence: Section 10.9 requires at least $5,000,000 of cyber and privacy liability insurance where HDI processes data belonging to, supplied by, or processed for the Company. That trigger encompasses processing Customer Data, although it is broader than the preferred trigger.

result.reason: The operative clause satisfies every preferred requirement and therefore also satisfies the fallback. It correctly directs the duties to HDI, applies them throughout the term, and preserves the existing headings and counterparts provision. It is not strictly minimal because the cyber-insurance trigger covers any data belonging to, supplied by, or processed for the Company, which is potentially broader than the specified Customer Data trigger.
